Olevsk New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Olevsk was initially controlled not by direct German administration but by German-aligned Ukrainian nationalists under Taras Bulba-Borovets, forming the short-lived 'Olevsk Republic' — a notable, distinct chapter in wartime Ukrainian nationalist history. Even under this initial regime, Jews who remained were subjected to brutal treatment, property confiscation, and some were murdered, before a formal German civil administration took over in November 1941 and confined the majority to a ghetto, where most were killed soon after. In the 1920s, Olevsk's Jews founded two agricultural collectives in the Kherson District.
